booking_owner.name: booking_owner
booking_owner.withCheck: owner_id = app_user_id() and exists (select 1 from portfolio p where p.id = portfolio_id and p.owner_id = app_user_id())

goal_share_state_check.name: goal_share_state_check
goal_share_state_check.value: ("goal_share"."grantee_id" is null) = ("goal_share"."accepted_at" is null) and ("goal_share"."grantee_id" is null) = ("goal_share"."token_hash" is not null)

instrument_global_symbol_idx.name: instrument_global_symbol_idx
instrument_global_symbol_idx.where: owner_id is null and symbol is not null

instrument_global_coingecko_idx.name: instrument_global_coingecko_idx
instrument_global_coingecko_idx.where: owner_id is null and coingecko_id is not null

instrument_global_metal_idx.name: instrument_global_metal_idx
instrument_global_metal_idx.where: owner_id is null and metal is not null

instrument_select.name: instrument_select
instrument_select.using: owner_id is null or owner_id = app_user_id()

instrument_insert.name: instrument_insert
instrument_insert.withCheck: owner_id is null or owner_id = app_user_id()

instrument_class_country_check.name: instrument_class_country_check
instrument_class_country_check.value: "instrument_class"."country" is null or char_length("instrument_class"."country") between 1 and 60

instrument_class_sector_check.name: instrument_class_sector_check
instrument_class_sector_check.value: "instrument_class"."sector" is null or char_length("instrument_class"."sector") between 1 and 60

instrument_class_any_check.name: instrument_class_any_check
instrument_class_any_check.value: "instrument_class"."country" is not null or "instrument_class"."sector" is not null

notification_text_check.name: notification_text_check
notification_text_check.value: char_length("notification"."title") between 1 and 120 and ("notification"."body" is null or char_length("notification"."body") <= 500) and char_length("notification"."dedupe_key") between 1 and 200

portfolio_share_state_check.name: portfolio_share_state_check
portfolio_share_state_check.value: ("portfolio_share"."grantee_id" is null) = ("portfolio_share"."accepted_at" is null) and ("portfolio_share"."grantee_id" is null) = ("portfolio_share"."token_hash" is not null)

road_settings_ranges.name: road_settings_ranges
road_settings_ranges.value: "road_settings"."target_cents" > 0 and "road_settings"."monthly_contribution_cents" >= 0 and "road_settings"."expected_return_bp" between -2000 and 3000 and "road_settings"."volatility_bp" between 0 and 10000
